changelog: [When to Segment]: added five precise, generalizable conditions for low-risk boundaries that were being missed (sentence-initial connective/discourse marker + full clause; embedded question mark + resuming clause; ~때 clause + filler + new clause, splitting after the filler; quotative -다고/-라고 clause + matrix clause; short response connective closing a brief acknowledgment attaches to the PRECEDING segment rather than starting the next).

[Never Segment]: added four precise conditions blocking damaging splits identified by evidence — inside a 왜(why)-triggered rhetorical-question scope, immediately after a conditional connective (-면/-다면) before its consequence, immediately after a -고 converb that a later conditional depends on, and multiple splits within a single filler/false-start-dominated run.
